backend/main.mo: Motoko canister providing user profile management with access control and storing predefined Valentine content.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing feature evidence, mapping features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of brief descriptions for each frontend file, summarizing content structures and editing features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining Valentine-themed color variables, dark mode rules, and float animations.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML scaffold mounting the React app and loading the main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Router and Query Client, wraps the app with EditableContentProvider, and renders global toasts.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedText.tsx: Component that animates text fade/slide-in unless reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Full-screen confetti heart overlay that auto-shows briefly unless reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/Decorations.tsx: Renders decorative hearts, sparkles, or corner images with optional animations based on reduced-motion.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout with header outlet, themed footer, and floating EditModeToggle.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Empty placeholder file for a music player component.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx: Displays a photo grid with clickable images that open a lightbox with navigation and reduced‑motion support.
Wraps route content with a fade-and-slide transition unless reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/content/valentineContent.ts: Defines the ValentineContent data model and provides default content including photos, letters, and proposal details.
frontend/src/editing/EditableContentProv: Manages editable Valentine content with draft storage, published syncing, auto‑saving, and update helpers.
frontend/src/editing/EditableText.tsx: Provides an inline editable text component that switches to input or textarea when edit mode is active.
frontend/src/editing/EditModeToggle.tsx: Renders an edit‑mode toggle with actions to publish, reload, reset, and exit editing via a dropdown and dialogs.
frontend/src/editing/imageSourceUtils.ts: Provides image URL validation and file-to-dataURL conversion with size and protocol checks.
frontend/src/editing/LettersEditor.tsx: UI for adding, editing, and deleting love-note letters using dialogs and editable form fields.
frontend/src/editing/localDraftStorage.t: Handles saving, loading, clearing, and versioning of draft Valentine content in localStorage.
frontend/src/editing/PhotoMemoriesEditor: UI component for adding, editing, validating, and deleting photo entries using local state and editable content context.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating related queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth, login flow, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and updating published Valentine content via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts: Hook that tracks the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting via a media query listener.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom Valentine color variables, dark mode tokens, animations, and reduced-motion rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/FinalPage.tsx: Renders the final celebration page with editable message and activity plan using animated UI components.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with editable heading/subheading, decorations, and a button navigating to the photos page.
frontend/src/pages/LoveNotePage.tsx: Displays animated love notes with editable content, optional editor mode, and navigation to the proposal page.
frontend/src/pages/PhotosMemoriesPage.ts: Shows editable photo memories with a gallery and optional editor, leading to the love note page.
Proposal question screen with editable text, a playful moving 'No' button, and navigation to the final page.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and Valentine-themed design tokens.
project_state.json: Project state file describing versions, issues, existing features, and new feature requests related to publishing and syncing edited site content. It outlines backend persistence needs, editor draft handling, and known deployment problems.
